resources.string: Create an editable offline local configuration with four proxy selectors: Jeemi, AI+Google, IM and Video. Each has a paired automatic selector, producing eight actual selectors. General rules combine site lists with CN GEO direct routing. App rules use the same site lists plus direct routing for common domestic Android packages, without GEO rules.

Create a template copy, then bind it through a subscription card’s configuration label. Use Rule mode; saved changes apply automatically while connected. Each proxy selector defaults to its Auto group, or you can pick a node manually. Tap the child group’s delay area to browse it. Edit app rules through the App list or YAML, including entries added from connection details. Group and rule-set editors offer an expandable Emoji grid.

Each copy adds 21 independent resources and preserves existing edits, bindings and the original empty app-routing template. Automatic groups are generated by the four parent groups. Creation never downloads rules or starts VPN; insufficient capacity fails atomically. App direct rules precede sites; general site rules precede CN direct routing. Both end with MATCH Jeemi, after the Home LAN prefix. Automatic groups share parent nodes and providers, with 300-second checks, 50 ms tolerance and lazy checking. No region exclusions are preset. Process matching must be enabled; Android may not identify every app. Rule snapshots do not update automatically.

Filter policy groups and rule sets using the saved configuration graph. The compact search accepts names and Emoji; rule sets also match their local YAML content. Counts show displayed resources and the category total.

Open the filter button to choose a configuration, including No config. Policy groups can be limited to selectors or logical rule groups; rule sets can be limited to one or more owners, including No group. Changing the configuration clears the group filter. Search supports | for OR, & for AND and ! for exclusion, including full-width variants. Tap a card to edit; its menu contains relationships, check preview and delete.

Filters change only this list; they do not enable rules, rewrite references or change VPN routing. Disabled references still count, and only stable IDs determine ownership. Notes remain available in the editor but are hidden on compact cards. Icons use the device Emoji font. Group Emoji may change its emitted selector name; saving validates all affected candidates and saved changes apply automatically to a running session.
Not enough resource slots. A template needs 21 free slots within the 100-resource limit.
